summary: Roadmap item 4 of dimension32-global-topology: singular loci of every A_5 rank-stratum piece, a stratification of each nullity stratum S_k with rank loci and smooth strata kept distinct, and the normal link of R_12 = V u B9 along V n B9.

reconciliation.note: Work runs on branch geometry/a5-strata-regularity; no claim is admitted until an independent verification from cd_core and a critical review confirm it.

scope: Evidence bundle docs/evidence/a5-strata-regularity (author script, result.json, README, independent verifier, verification.md), the claim a5-strata-regularity and the boundary text of dimension32-global-topology. Kernel bundles, attachments and homology (items 5 to 8) stay out of scope.
next_action: Compute the singular locus of each piece by the Jacobian criterion on the six slice families of Lemma 5, with radicality settled before any singularity claim.

steps.action: Determine Sing P for P in N_+, N_-, V, B9, W8, E8-bar, V(Q), V(G): smoothness off the named locus from full Jacobian rank of a generating set, and singularity on it only from a radical ideal, a tangent-cone multiplicity above 1 or several local branches.
steps.acceptance: Fails if a point off the named locus has Jacobian rank below codimension for a radical generating set, or a claimed singular point has a tangent cone equal to a linear space of the piece dimension.

steps.action: Decide the non-nested intersections W8 n E8-bar, W8 n V, V(Q) n V(G) and give each nullity stratum S_k a partition into smooth locally closed pieces with dimensions and componentwise closure incidences.
steps.acceptance: Fails if a partition piece is not smooth of constant dimension, two pieces overlap, or a closure incidence disagrees with an exact point or curve.

steps.action: Compute the normal slice of R_12 = V u B9 at x0 = e_1 + e_18 and at a second point of V n B9 minus N_+-, and decide whether the transverse type is constant along V n B9 minus N_+-.
steps.acceptance: Fails if the curve branch count of V or the surface type of B9 in the slice differs between the two points without the record saying so, or a link is stated without a computed singularity type.

steps.action: An opus re-check from cd_core re-derives every admitted subclaim with separate code.
steps.acceptance: Fails if any admitted subclaim is refuted or left unchecked without being withdrawn from the claim.

steps.action: Add claim a5-strata-regularity with its replay and update the boundary of dimension32-global-topology for confirmed subclaims only.
steps.acceptance: research_state.py --check and plan_tracker.py check pass, the four pr.yml checks are green and Codex reports clean on the PR head.
